#  | has-a.space Docs

> Here you'll find detailed guides, the JSON file structure, and more. If you'd like to contribute to our documentation, visit our documentation repository on GitHub.

- [has-a.space Documentation](https://docs.has-a.space/index.md): has-a.space Documentation
- [Quickstart Guide](https://docs.has-a.space/quickstart.md): Before you start the process of making an has-a.space domain, make sure you have the following:
- [Domain Structure](https://docs.has-a.space/useful/domain-structure.md): To register a subdomain, submit a pull request with a new JSON file in the domains directory. For example, to register example.has-a.space, create a file
- [📘 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://docs.has-a.space/useful/faq.md): This page provides our most frequently asked questions regarding our service.
- [Resources](https://docs.has-a.space/useful/resources.md): This page provides a collection of resources to help you understand key concepts related to domain management, such as DNS, records, and more.

## Guides

- [GitHub Pages](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/github-pages.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a GitHub Pages site and pointing your has-a.space subdomain to it.
- [Setting up Codeberg Pages with an has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/codeberg-pages.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a Codeberg Pages (or any git-pages host) website and pointing your has-a.space subdomain to it.
- [Setting up Netlify with an has-a.space Subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/netlify.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a Netlify deployment and pointing your has-a.space subdomain towards it.
- [Setting up Zoho Mail using has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/zoho-mail.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up custom email in Zoho Mail with your has-a.space subdomain.
- [Setting up ImprovMX with an has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/improvmx.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up ImprovMX with your has-a.space subdomain.
- [Setting up DanBot Hosting with an has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/dbh.md): This hosting provider has changed a lot in recent times, so this guide may not be up to date with the current system the hosting provider has.
- [Setting up Firebase Hosting with an has-a.space Subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/firebase.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a Firebase Hosting site and pointing your has-a.space subdomain towards it.
- [Hashnode Blog](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/hashnode.md): When you create your Hashnode blog, Hashnode provides a free hashnode.dev subdomain for you. However, you can alternatively set up your own has-a.space subdomain.
- [Setting up has-a.space with Railway](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/railway.md): Navigate to the dashboard > project > service
- [Setting up Render with an has-a.space Subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/render.md): This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a Render deployment and pointing your has-a.space subdomain towards it.
- [Setting up Replit with an has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/replit.md): Follow the instructions in the Replit Workspace Guide on how to create a project.
- [Setting up Discord domain connection with your has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/discord-verification.md): Open your Discord app and press Settings.
- [Setting up a Bluesky custom handle with an has-a.space subdomain](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/bsky-handle.md): Open your Bluesky app and go to your profile Settings.
- [Setting up other services with has-a.space](https://docs.has-a.space/guides/other.md): Read the domain file structure and set up the records accordingly.
